title: Impulse Body Text 2
description: The Assisted Solo strategies work to short-circuit habitual patterns of coordination. They also challenge the dancers to maintain a state of readiness, scanning constantly to respond to several simultaneous inputs and external impulses. This results in a special form of concentration that is evident when you watch them perform.
